title: Preview the claim sweep: idle, crashed and unclaimed work across your enforced repositories (read-only)
phrases: which work claims have gone stale
are any task reservations expired or stuck
did anyone commit without checking in first

safety.notes: Always runs the sweep with readOnly: it reports what would expire, finalize or close and never writes the claims store, worktrees or branches. Run git-manager sweep without --read-only yourself to apply it.
